title: "[BUG] "

---

### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Affected File Format
* Extension (e.g. `.step`, `.psd`, `.svg`, `.obj`, `.blend`):
* Shell Component affected:
  - [ ] File Explorer Thumbnail
  - [ ] File Explorer Preview Pane (`Alt+P`)
  - [ ] Management App (`ShellThumbs.exe`)

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Windows File Explorer.
2. Navigate to folder containing the file.
3. Observe the behavior or error.

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen (e.g., thumbnail renders preview, preview pane renders interactive 3D model, etc.).

### Environment
- **Windows Version**: (e.g., Windows 11 24H2, Windows 11 23H2, Windows 10 22H2)
- **ShellThumbs Version**: (e.g., 1.0.0)
- **Display Resolution & Scaling**: (e.g., 2560x1440 @ 125%)
- **GPU**: (e.g., NVIDIA RTX 4070 / Intel Iris Xe / AMD Radeon)

### Sample File (Optional but recommended)
If possible, please attach a non-confidential sample file or zip demonstrating the issue so we can test and fix it quickly.

### Screenshots / Logs
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.
